name: Gateway -> Broker contract (see docs/metrics.md)
info:
Publishes one JSON snapshot per device to the Broker (QoS 1, not retained):
  topic   heatpump-monitor/gateway/<device>   device = heat_pump | electricity_meter | heat_meter
  payload {"ts":"<RFC3339 UTC, ms, read start>","metrics":{"<name>": <number>, ...}}
Numbers only; invalid/unsupported values are omitted (never null). If any read of a cycle fails, that cycle publishes nothing.
Polling: heat_pump 10 s, electricity_meter 10 s (offset 4 s), heat_meter 60 s (battery).
Metric names, units, registers and M-Bus records: docs/metrics.md in the heatpump-monitor repo.
The function code is unit-tested: node --test nodered/test/ (tests load it from this file).
Heat pump control (Write silent / Write energy) at the bottom is existing behaviour, outside the monitoring project.
